senses.gloss: m. (cmp. of <he>יֵי</he>, <cite ref="D00002"><he>דְּ־</he></cite> a. <cite ref="M01696"><he>מַן</he></cite> or <cite ref="M00023"><he>מַאי</he></cite>)

units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 6:6">Targ. Job VI, 6</cite> (sec. vers.). Targ. II Esth. I, 9.—
<cite ref="Gittin 56b:5">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>בעי מינאי מ׳ וכ׳</he> ask something of me that I may grant thee.

<cite ref="Horayot 13b:14-15">Hor. 13ᵇ</cite>. <he>דילמא … איכא בי מדרשא מ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>מילתא</he>) is perhaps something (a conspiracy against me) going on at college? <cite ref="Sanhedrin 38a:2">Snh. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>ולא הוו קאמרי ולא מ׳</he> and they did not speak at all.
<cite ref="Gittin 14a:10">Gitt. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>ולא פש גביה ולא מ׳</he> there was no surplus whatever in his account.
<cite ref="Shabbat 62b:9">Sabb. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>ולא אמר ליה ולא מ׳</he> and he said nothing to him (did not object).
<cite ref="Shabbat 62b:9">Ib.</cite> <he>כל מ׳ דאית ביה וכ׳</he> whatever is connected with enjoyment.
<cite ref="Eruvin 103b:7">Erub. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>ותו לא מ׳</he> and there is nothing more to be said against it; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91:6">Gen. R. s. 91</cite> <he>אי … טעין לן במדוי דמכסא</he> (ed. Wil. <he>במדיו</he>; read: <he>במידי</he>) if we find that he argues with us about an affair of custom; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 148:7">Yalk. ib. 148</cite> <he>במדוי במכסא</he> (corr. acc.).

senses.gloss: (cmp. מִי a. כְּלוּם) [is there?] will he, will it? is it? &c.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 53b:5">Ab. Zar. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ … מיהדר הדור</he> will the war of Joshua come up again?; a. fr.—
Shebu. 20ᵇ, a. fr. מ׳ איריא is this an argument?, v. אִרְיָא.—מ׳ דהוה אַ־ something which can be placed by the side of, because it is analogous to.
<cite ref="Niddah 3a:30">Nidd. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ דהוה אהרגשת וכ׳</he> because it is like the sensation of &c.
Ḥull. 19ᵃ; a. fr.—[Not to be confounded with מִידֵי out of the power of, v. יָד.]
